pages.text: Snow stopped, and the sun came out. The three agreed to play tag in the alley.
Kiki wanted to play, but Kiki was chosen to be it first.
Kiki turned away and sat. "I will not play."
Nono asked, "What is wrong?" Kiki did not answer.
Gugu became it instead. The two ran through the alley.
Kiki stayed turned away at the doorway. Laughter came only from the other side.
In winter, the sun set quickly. Kiki had not run even once.
Grandpa Badger sat beside Kiki, then demonstrated turning sharply away just like Kiki.
The next morning, all three gathered again. Kiki became it again.
"I am it!" Kiki ran happily through the alley.
